messages.subject: Re: App works well on "Run App" button but not on actual server location
parts:
That makes no sense (at least without seeing your code). Are you writing anything to disk in your app? I don't know what else would cause values to be picked up from "Run App" and used in an app run from Shiny Server.

Have you checked the Shiny Server log files? /var/log/shiny-server/*.log

On Wed, May 25, 2016 at 8:27 AM zan <raizan...@gmail.com> wrote:

Dear Shiny Experts,

I have this strange problem that the app does not work the same when (a) I click "Run App" on my RStudio server installed on my AWS EC2 server, and when (b) I run the same app directly from the browser. E.g.:

(a) Upon clicking "Run App", I run an instance (not sure if I'm using the right word here) of the app on ,e.g.:
http://my.server.address/rstudio/p/5020/
This works fine, and my leaflet map updates nicely with the click of the "Update" button for the year and month I selected (see below).

(b) But when I try to run directly on:
http://my.server.address:3838/rccsea/
The leaflet map does not respond to clicking of the "Update" button, and even stranger, it picks up whatever the former (http://my.server.address/rstudio/p/5020/) last loaded onto the map.

It's puzzling me. I was wondering if anyone has encountered this before and know what could have gone wrong. Thanks.
